description: An interpolation witness for finite signed NNF sides \(L,R\) contains an actual NNF formula \(I\), primitive proof trees of \(L,I\) and \(R,I^\perp\), and \(\operatorname{at}(I)\subseteq\operatorname{At}(L)\cap\operatorname{At}(R)\), where each side vocabulary is the union of its occurring atom names.
